figures.name: core/C03_category_coloured_graph
figures.caption: Complete snapshot grouped by node type within the two fixed domains. Every node and directed edge is retained, including isolates and parallel records. Node colour identifies type; size is constant. Normal edges are grey; cross-domain edges orange. Type placement and within-type assignment are drawing choices, not communities or scientific similarity. Type labels show node counts. Dense links require zooming.
